discovery.instrumentation_note: The 80 raw count is employer-level and source-name-deduplicated. Search-result rows and Telegram placeholder listings were not counted as employers. Saturated 20-employer regional lanes were stopped immediately after the measured early-reject threshold exceeded 70%.
